recovery.actualFailureBody: Cloudflare Just a moment / JavaScript-and-cookies challenge

recovery.addressing: Filebase29 and Pinata20 used direct file CIDs; Pinata9 used the immutable root CID/path. Every child CID also matches the public folder listing and verified CAR.

oldRoots: Preserved; explicit small prior-root readbacks underway.
assemblyRecovery: Initial assembly expected literal PASS instead of the actual precise consumer status. It stopped before writing a report; corrected to the exact measured status and required semantic assertions.
qualification: Dated byte/pin observations, not guaranteed permanent provider availability. No paid plan change or old pin removal.

directoryAndPriorRootProof.effects: Read-only CAR block derivation and bounded unauthenticated public GETs; no source or credential changes, rebuild, pin or upload.
